source: Production plugin Swing UI captured in isolated DataGrip 2026.2 SDK, annotated sample-metadata preview; no database execution

chapters.title: Copy. Paste. Review.
chapters.caption: Copy objects in the database tree, then paste onto the destination.

chapters.title: 01  Confirm the destination
chapters.caption: Confirm the source and destination using your DataGrip connections.

chapters.title: 02  Choose your objects
chapters.caption: Select what to copy. Searching preserves your selected objects.

chapters.title: 03  Configure each object
chapters.caption: Use Advanced to rename objects and choose structure, data, or both.

chapters.title: 04  Review full definitions
chapters.caption: Review indexes, collations and triggers in the editable target definition.

chapters.title: 05  Check the transfer plan
chapters.caption: Review objects, target names, copy content and conversion notes.

chapters.title: 06  Read the SQL before starting
chapters.caption: Inspect the generated SQL. Confirm the plan before starting.
